meta.name: predictable-revenue
meta.description: Build a scalable outbound B2B sales machine with specialized roles (SDR, AE, CSM). Use when the user mentions "outbound sales", "Cold Calling 2.0", "cold email sequences", "sales pipeline", "SDR process", "sales development", "build an outbound sales team", or "fill my pipeline". Also trigger when setting up a B2B SaaS sales team from scratch or building a lead-qualification framework to improve close rates. Covers the three lead types (seeds/nets/spears), role specialization, the referral-email method, ANUM qualification, and pipeline math. For offer design, see hundred-million-offers. For persuasion science, see influence-psychology.

copy.tagline: 搭建可扩展的B2B外呼销售体系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从零搭建B2B销售团队或优化外呼流程。
copy.tagline_en: Build a scalable B2B outbound sales machine
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building a B2B sales team from scratch or optimizing outbound processes.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你搭建可预测的B2B外呼销售体系，包括角色分工（SDR、AE、CSM）、冷呼叫2.0流程、线索分类（种子/网/矛）、ANUM资格认定和管道数学。
howto.when: 当你提到“外呼销售”、“冷呼叫2.0”、“冷邮件序列”、“销售管道”、“SDR流程”等关键词，或需要从零搭建B2B SaaS销售团队、建立线索资格认定框架时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个SDR团队的外呼流程。
say.note: Claude会输出冷呼叫2.0的步骤和模板。

say.text: 如何用ANUM方法评估这个线索？
say.note: Claude会给出ANUM四个维度的提问示例。

say.text: 我的销售目标是100万美元，需要多少SDR？
say.note: Claude会使用管道数学公式计算所需SDR人数。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you to build a predictable B2B outbound sales machine, including role specialization (SDR, AE, CSM), Cold Calling 2.0 process, lead types (seeds/nets/spears), ANUM qualification, and pipeline math.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "outbound sales", "Cold Calling 2.0", "cold email sequences", "sales pipeline", "SDR process", etc., or when setting up a B2B SaaS sales team from scratch or building a lead-qualification framework.

say_en.text: Help me design an outbound process for an SDR team.
say_en.note: Claude outputs Cold Calling 2.0 steps and templates.

say_en.text: How do I qualify this lead using ANUM?
say_en.note: Claude provides ANUM question examples for each criterion.

say_en.text: My revenue goal is $1M, how many SDRs do I need?
say_en.note: Claude uses pipeline math to calculate required SDRs.
